name: @pipeworx/mcp-wyoming-code

tools.name: wy_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Wyoming Statutes (W.S.) — Wyoming state law — by citation. "6-2-101" is murder in the first degree (Title 6, Crimes and Offenses); "20-1-105" is divorce grounds (Title 20). Accepts natural forms: "6-2-101", "W.S. 6-2-101", "§ 6-2-101". Returns the current statutory text, the section heading, and — where the source carries one cleanly — an enactment/amendment "history" note; many sections have no such note (Wyoming does not uniformly separate amendment history from body text). Wyoming publishes the CURRENT edition only; no historical/prior-year version is available online. Title 97 (the Constitution) is not covered — it uses "Article N, Section N" citations, a different scheme. Keyless. Use for "what does W.S. 6-2-101 say" or to check a Wyoming statute a case or contract relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "6-2-101" (murder) or "20-1-105" (divorce grounds). Title-chapter-section, dash separated; a few titles carry a decimal (e.g. "34.1-1-101", Uniform Commercial Code).

tools.name: wy_search
tools.description: Search the Wyoming Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed firearm permit", "murder penalty". Full-text search over the statutory body text across all titles (except Title 97, the Constitution). Returns matching citations and headings; call wy_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wyoming-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wyoming-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
